sections.title: Letter sound ka
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (ka) /ka/. Its main sound is heard in the word (kilo) /ˈki.lo/, which means a unit of weight. This letter always has one sound.

sections.title: How to say ka
paragraphs: Lift the back of your tongue to touch the soft part of the roof of your mouth. Block the air completely for a brief moment. Drop your tongue to let the air burst out. Do not vibrate your vocal cords. Hold your hand before your mouth to feel only a very soft puff of air.

sections.title: Spelling rules for ka
paragraphs: This letter always makes the sound heard in (kilo) /ˈki.lo/ in all positions. You hear that same sound at the start of a word in (kilo) /ˈki.lo/. You also hear it at the very end of a word in (anorak) /a.noˈrak/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid with ka
paragraphs: Do not release a strong puff of air as in the English word kite. A plosive is a consonant where the air stops for a moment and then bursts out. Keep this plosive dry and clean. Hold a tissue before your lips to check. The paper must barely move when you speak.
